detail.title: CP-UVR-1601E1V-I
features: Supports HDCVI, AHD, TVI, CVBS and IP video input
Supports up to 18 channels of IPC access, including 2 additional IP channels + 16  analog channels, with the option to convert all analog channels to IP
16 Channels two-way talk over coaxial cable allows for seamless communication  between the camera, client and recorder
16 Channels IMD+ for analog channels or 18 Channels IMD by camera which     allows the device to trigger accurate alarms for humans and vehicles
16 Channels AI Coding saves on storage and bandwidth while                 maintaining the details of targets in videos
Instastream, H.265, H.264+, H.264 dual stream video compression

General.IMD+ by DVR: 16 channels: Secondary filtering for human and vehicle, reducing false alarms caused by  leaves, rain and lighting condition change
General.IP Camera Input: Up to 18 Channels of IPC access                                                                                                                                  2 IP Channel by default + 16 Channels (analog channels are converted to IP channels)                              Incoming bandwidth: 64 Mbps, recording bandwidth: 64 Mbps and outgoing bandwidth: 64  Mbps
General.Video Frame Rate: Main stream: the 1st channel 1080N/720p@1 fps– 25/30 fps, others 1080N/720p@1 fps–15  fps; 960H/D1/CIF@1 fps–25/30 fps                                                                                                             Sub stream: CIF@1 fps–7 fps
General.Video Display Split: When IP extension mode not enabled: 1/4/8/9/16                                                                                 When IP extension mode enabled: 1/4/8/9/16/25
General.Video Compression: AI Coding, Instastream, H.265, H.264+, H.264
General.Protocols: HTTP, HTTPS, TCP/IP, IPv4, IPv6, RTSP, UDP, NTP, DHCP, DNS, SMTP, UPnP, IP Filter, FTP,  DDNS, SNMP, Alarm Server, InstaOn, Auto Connect, IP Search, ONVIF (Profile T, Profile S,                Profile G), CGI, SDK
General.Playback Mode: Instant playback, General playback, Event playback, Tag playback, Smart playback
General.General Alarm: Motion detection, HDCVI alarm, Camera external alarm, Network alarm, PIR alarm
General.Abnormality Alarm: Error (No disk, Disk error, Low space, Low quota space, Network disconnection, IP conflict,  MAC conflict), Video loss, Video tampering, Camera offline
General.Alarm Linkage: Record, Snapshot (panoramic), IPC external alarm output, Audio, Buzzer, Log, Preset, Email
General.Two-way Talk: Coaxial two-way talk: 16-channel BNC Local and network user two-way talk: Shares the same  audio input with the first channel
General.Disk Interface: 1 SATA port, up to 16 TB. This limit varies depending on the environment temperature.
